time_contract.source_bar_logical_timezone: historical Rakuten MT4 server wall-clock represented as timezone-aware logical timestamps
time_contract.server_offset_rule: UTC+2 standard time and UTC+3 while US DST is active, using the repository historical ServerToUtc authority
time_contract.dst_rule: US DST: second Sunday in March 07:00 UTC through first Sunday in November 06:00 UTC; conversion is frozen to tools/build_usdjpy_b02_f05_hyp024_inputs_v2.py and tools/usdjpy_native_htf_state_data_v1.py
time_contract.bar_timestamp_meaning: bucket_server is the opening timestamp of the exact server H4 slot
time_contract.completed_h4_definition: exactly 16 distinct consecutive M15 bars whose logical server timestamps match every quarter-hour in one H4 slot
time_contract.partial_h4_handling: discard; it never updates close, EMA, state or information time
time_contract.information_time: server H4 slot end converted to UTC through the frozen historical ServerToUtc rule
time_contract.entry_reference: latest H4 row with information_time <= entry_utc
time_contract.simultaneous_entry_and_h4_close: the newly completed H4 row is visible first; exact information-time match is allowed
time_contract.missing_m15_bar: invalidate the entire H4 slot; do not synthesize or forward-fill a close
time_contract.weekend_gap: no synthetic bars; EMA advances only on subsequent valid completed exact H4 slots
time_contract.duplicate_m15_bar: hard error before aggregation; duplicate logical timestamp is not resolved by keep-first/keep-last

indicator_contract.seed: first valid close seeds each recursive EMA internally, but published EMA/state remain uninitialized until 24 valid completed H4 observations
indicator_contract.update_order: for each completed H4 slot in ascending information_time: update fast EMA from prior fast and current close, update slow EMA from prior slow and current close, then derive state
indicator_contract.formula: ema_t = alpha*close_t + (1-alpha)*ema_(t-1), equivalent to pandas ewm(adjust=false)
indicator_contract.rounding: no rounding before comparison or ledger output; IEEE-754 binary64; CSV renders 12 decimal places
indicator_contract.state_long: fast EMA > slow EMA after slow initialization
indicator_contract.state_short: fast EMA < slow EMA after slow initialization
indicator_contract.state_neutral: before slow initialization or exact binary64 equality
indicator_contract.neutral_permission: blocked for both Long and Short

market_data_contract.ask_mid_relation: Ask and Mid are not inputs to H4 state; trade-side permission is evaluated independently of spread
market_data_contract.live_and_tester_module: one shared Core H4 state module must supply both tester and live entry admission

permission_contract.feature_flag: default false to preserve existing Baseline

logging_contract.ema_format: decimal with at least 12 digits after decimal
